text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheered on by a large crowd full of hopeful spectators, Taiki Shuttle is determined not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beating Silence Suzuka will continue her winning streak in the G1 sprints, giving her an additional push toward becoming Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, Taiki Shuttle keeps blazing forward in order to achieve her dream!
